_note: Zones (docs/design/zones.md, build step 2). One row per zone. band is the lab level the content is tuned for, [min, max]; bands overlap on purpose and are not gates. Ryan's anchors: underground about 5 to 20, the moons about 21 to 50, far sites 50 to 99; every other band edge is [PLACEHOLDER]. Names come from the doc; the ids, the word lists and the far-site entrances are [PLACEHOLDER] (invented for code). hazards and finds are words from ZoneData.HAZARDS and ZoneData.FINDS (section 5 and section 4 of the doc; far sites use the one-line ideas of section 11). hub_scene is the res:// path of the zone's hub scene, or an empty string while it has none; only the basalt tunnels have a scene today. entrance is how the first visit gets there (section 2, section 8). area is underground, moon or far. tarantula_hook is a short string, empty when the zone has none. notes holds Ryan's answers from section 14.1 as short strings. No hazard or find has any rule or number yet; this table is data only.

warning._note: The soft-gate warning of docs/design/zones.md section 7.1 [PLACEHOLDER words]. line takes the band start, the lab level and one of the two lines; hard takes the lab level of the zone's deep_gate row in data/skills.json lab_gates.
